newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's coffee exports fall 22.8 pct in Jan-Apr.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's coffee exports fall 22.8 pct in Jan-Apr.

text.p: Ecuador's coffee exports fell 22.8 percent in the first four months of 1997 to 246,110 60-kg bags due to the retention plan of the Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC), an exporters group said Friday.
National Coffee Exporter Association said Ecuador shipped 318,959 bags in the first four months of 1996.
Coffee revenues for the January-April period fell to $23.3 million from $33.4 million in the comparable period of 1996.
In 1996, Ecuador's coffee exports fell to 1.56 million 60-kg bags from 1.9 million bags exported in 1995.
Ecuador plans to export 1.4 million bags between July 1996 and June 1997.
Coffee is Ecuador's fifth export earner after oil, bananas, shrimps and cacao.
